_: Nhip do hoi the quyet dinh (GAME_SPEC muc 7). MOI so nam o day, khong nam trong .ts (CLAUDE.md luat 2).
_gioQuet: Bao nhieu gio game moi quet dieu kien mot lan. Bang so chi chot moi gio nen quet day hon la vo ich.
_gioGianCach: Toi thieu ngan nay gio game giua hai the. The `khan` duoc pha luat nay - thanh pho dang chay mau thi khong the bat cho.
_gioLapLai: Cung mot the khong duoc hoi lai trong ngan nay gio game.
_toiDaMotVan: Tran so the trong mot van, chan truong hop dieu kien cu dung mai va game thanh bam nut lien tuc.
_thoiDai: Sau thoi dai (Phase 8, GAME_SPEC muc 9). `soO` la so o chinh phu lap the chinh sach duoc. `len` la dieu kien len doi KE TIEP: `soCongNghe` la tong so cong nghe da hoc ca van, `soNha` la so cong trinh dang co. `len: null` la chua mo duong len.
_me: Ten me atlas cua doi do. Doi doi la doi atlas - TECH_SPEC muc 2: nha atlas cu bang gl.deleteTexture, khong giu lai 'phong khi can'. Phase 8A chua nuong me hien dai nen ca sau doi cung tro `trung_co_2`; Phase 8B chi sua dung cot nay.
_gioChoDoiThe: Doi mot the chinh sach xong thi phai cho ngan nay gio game moi duoc doi tiep. Chua co vang nen phi doi the tinh bang thoi gian.
_khoa_doi_4: Doi 4 tro di chua co cong nghe rieng (tech.json moi co ba doi dau) nen `len` de null - len toi doi 4 la het duong, dung nhu KE_HOACH Phase 12. Them cong nghe cho ba doi sau thi mo lai.
